This document 
outlines the equipment inspection I6, which must be performed on an annually 
bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

Generators (for units 1, 2) 
type: THDI 93/43, 187.5 MVA,150 MW, 10.3kA, 10.5kV, 50Hz, 0.8 PF

Gالمولدات (للوحدات 3، 4)

مختار عبد اللطيف 
ماضي قطاع رأس عتاقة 
PS.

تم قبول هذه الوثيقة من قبل المهندس. سمير عبد الجليل؛ منسق EDEPC MPIS ومعتمد 
 بقلم المحاسب محمود سليمان مدير عام EDEPC 
 التفتيش المالي ومشرف رئيس التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة 
 القطاع.
احتياطات السلامة

A work 
 permit must be issued, the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 ID category,

Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,

Safety and healthy equipment must be used as 
 safety shoes, and safety Helmet ... etc.

No smoking beside the generator is filled by 
 hydrogen gas.

Never remove more than one brush from exciter 
 (ground fault detection system).
The unit in service.
